packageRules.description: Windows CI is pinned to windows-2022 on purpose: windows-2025 has audio device issues (see ci.yml). Move it by hand once that is understood.
The compose file is an example users copy. Pinning :latest to a digest would freeze their image, so leave it alone.
sphinx-toolbox (docs/conf.py uses sphinx_toolbox.collapse) requires sphinx-autodoc-typehints<3.6.0, up to 4.3.1 at least. Lift this when sphinx-toolbox does.
